# Risk Analytics & Trust Requirements Checklist: 004-risk-analytics-trust

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and testability of the requirements for the path-based risk analytics, termsheet extraction, and PDF export feature.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness
- [x] CHK001 Are UI state requirements defined for when a long-running simulation exceeds the 5-second performance goal (e.g. progressive rendering)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact memory limits or instance constraints documented for the Cloud Run deployment handling heavy Monte Carlo simulations? [Completeness, Plan]
- [x] CHK003 Are concurrent request scaling and concurrency requirements documented given the serverless Cloud Run architecture? [Completeness, Plan]
- [x] CHK004 Are fallback requirements defined for when the public market-data source is completely unavailable or rate-limits requests? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity
- [x] CHK005 Are the exact statistical definitions for the "worst-5% average loss" (e.g., Conditional Value at Risk / Expected Shortfall) mathematically unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Are the specific definitions for "2008-style crash" and "2020-style crash" explicitly quantified with percentage drops and timelines? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK007 Is the definition of "implied cost percent" mathematically specified for zero-cost structures like accumulators? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK008 Do the requirements specify the exact layout and dimensions for the Advisor-Ready PDF output (A4 vs US Letter, margins)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage
- [x] CHK009 Are edge-case requirements defined for termsheets that span multiple languages or character sets? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for zero-state scenarios where a product is loaded but no assumptions have been entered? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements specified for partial data extraction failures (e.g. parsing PDF layout fails but text is readable)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements & Architecture
- [x] CHK012 Are explicit latency thresholds documented for the `google-genai` termsheet extraction phase? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Are security requirements for handling the Gemini API key in the frontend (if any) explicitly prohibited per the Zero-Retention policy? [Consistency, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK014 Are payload size limits specified for the multipart form-data upload for termsheets? [Clarity, Contracts]
